attachments.insertion_landmark: proximal phalanx of the little toe

actions: abducts and flexes the little toe

functional_compartments.name: Single fiber population
functional_compartments.function_note: Most lateral muscle of the first plantar layer, forming the lateral border of the foot -- the foot's structural mirror of abductor hallucis on the medial side.
